name: merge-commit-policy
title: Decide and implement one merge-commit policy
description: One recorded decision resolving the three-way merge-commit contradiction between the planning-recovery validator (rejects cited merge commits as planning_recovery_commit_non_linear even though merge-main-first-then-record is the prescribed procedure, observed PR #350), the record-session recorder (derive_work_commits scans git log without --no-merges and its workspace-only filter passes merge commits on both the clean-merge and combined-diff branches), and session-numbering D3. After the decision, fix exactly one side — recorder or validator, never both — and make the losing side's diagnostic name the remedy. Absorbs 08-07-planning-recovery-rejects-merge-commit and 08-07-record-session-merge-commit from the 2026-08-08 backlog consolidation.
